# ceryx_route (Data Source)

Reads one Ceryx route. Fails if Ceryx has no route for `source`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ceryx_route" "app" {
  source = "app.example.com"
}

output "app_target" {
  value = data.ceryx_route.app.target
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `source` (String) Host name the route matches.

### Read-Only

- `certificate_path` (String) TLS certificate path inside the Ceryx container, if set.
- `enforce_https` (Boolean) Whether plain HTTP requests redirect to HTTPS.
- `key_path` (String) TLS private key path inside the Ceryx container, if set.
- `mode` (String) `proxy` or `redirect`.
- `target` (String) Where requests go.
